title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库是Fernando Amaral教授的完整人工智能培训课程资料，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式AI、自然语言处理、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法和模糊逻辑等内容，包含理论讲解与Python实战项目及笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, and more, with theory and hands-on Python projects and notebooks.
